description: This file defines cache-related macros, inline functions, and constants for ARM64 architecture in the Zephyr RTOS, including cache line size retrieval, cache invalidation, cleaning, and enabling/disabling functions.

methods.name: arch_dcache_line_size_get
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the data cache line for ARM64 architecture.

methods.name: arch_dcache_range
methods.description: Performs cache operations (invalidate, clean, or clean and invalidate) over a specified memory range.

methods.name: arch_dcache_flush_all
methods.description: Stub function for flushing entire data cache (not supported).

methods.name: arch_dcache_invd_all
methods.description: Stub function for invalidating entire data cache (not supported).

methods.name: arch_dcache_flush_and_invd_all
methods.description: Stub function for flushing and invalidating entire data cache (not supported).

methods.name: arch_dcache_flush_range
methods.description: Flushes (writes back) a range of data cache.

methods.name: arch_dcache_invd_range
methods.description: Invalidates a range of data cache.

methods.name: arch_dcache_flush_and_invd_range
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates a range of data cache.

methods.name: arch_dcache_enable
methods.description: Enables data cache (no operation in this implementation).

methods.name: arch_dcache_disable
methods.description: Disables data cache (no operation in this implementation).
